SocOps is reference only - do not copy code blindly
Do NOT modify existing Owner Mode workflow, SaaS layer, or attack tests

All protected actions must enforce authorization server-side
All meaningful mutations must emit audit events
No silent mutations of approved/issued/validated/locked records

Financial metrics must be deterministic (no randomization)
Idempotency required or protected against duplicate submission
No TODOs, placeholders, stubs, or fake implementations
Every significant change routes to BusinessConditionProfile reevaluation
Concurrency-safe update patterns for governed records
No collapsing distinct entities for convenience
